name: My Zypps - Ounce - Orange Cream Pop
description:
Sun-grown, full-bud, full ounce. The My Zypps Orange Cream Pop ounce delivers a full 28 grams of quality sun-grown flower — cured for full flavor and a smooth, even burn.

Orange Cream Pop nails that frozen-treat nostalgia: bright, juicy orange up front swirled with smooth vanilla cream and a sweet, mellow finish.

28G sun-grown flower — full ounce of whole bud
Best value — full-ounce pricing at the lowest cost per gram
Signature Orange Cream Pop flavor — juicy orange swirled with vanilla cream

My Zypps Orange Cream Pop is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
